messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Hosted API queue growth detected in us-east-1. p95=7.2s p99=18.4s. queue_length=28,400. error_rate 4.3%. tagging as P1. paging #ops and #sre. :rotating_light:
eli: seeing huge GPU pool saturation on us-east-prod-gpu-pool-3. many pods in Pending with `InsufficientGPU` and `ProvisionerRateLimit` spikes.
ravi: autoscaler logs show repeated `CreateInstanceQuotaExceeded` from cloud provider at 14:02 UTC. autoscaler retries back off, then marks group as unhealthy.
maya: cloud quota ticket earlier today was still pending. we hit soft quota. trying a manual override now but provider returning 429 on instance create.
ops_oncall: I'm on it — pausing non-critical canaries, opening temp throttle for low-priority customers to reduce burst. 
eli: customer-facing p99s are skyrocketing, timeouts on generation endpoints. lots of retries, makes backlog worse. we need a mitigation path asap.
sre_lead: plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model for non-SLA tenants 2) temporarily increase eviction threshold to free up GPUs 3) open escalated quota request + support call 4) if possible, route a subset of traffic to dedicated-reserved capacity. agree?
maya: doing 1 now — updating route policy to prefer `gpt-small-q4` for traffic class `non-sla`. command: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/route/update -d '{"route":"/generate","policy":"fallback: gpt-small-q4 if queue>1000"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${OPS_TOKEN}'```
deploy-bot: deployment started: route-policy-update by maya (job 7821).
ops_oncall: 2) bumping eviction threshold from 15m->5m on us-east pools to encourage pod churn and free KV cache. issuing: ```kubectl -n inference patch configmap pool-config -p '{"eviction_minutes":"5"}'```
eli: warning: eviction will increase cold-start latency but better than full queue collapse. we should also throttle client SDK bursts at gateway.
ravi: trying to manually scale provisioner up but hitting provider rate limit — "RateLimitExceeded.CreateNodeGroup". logged into cloud console to attempt quota override but needs phone escalation.
customer_success: CS: multiple enterprise customers complaining about timeouts. notifying impacted accounts, offering status updates. asking for ETA.
sre_lead: temporary ETA: expect p95 to normalize in ~10-15m after route change and eviction, p99 improvement TBD until more instances come online. put public status note: "mitigations in progress".
maya: route policy change rolled, traffic shifted ~22% off heavy models. queue length dropped to ~18k in 6m. p95 -> 5.8s, p99 -> 12.9s. progress. :thumbsup:
ops_oncall: started quota escalation with provider support via phone, case #CLOUD-9382. asked for immediate emergency increase of GPU quota in us-east.
eli: monitoring CVM (cold VM) failures — several pods failed after eviction due to missing artifact in edge cache. rolling a quick artifact republish to S3; command: ```scripts/publish-runtime-artifacts.sh --region us-east```
ravi: artifact republish succeeded, new pods are coming up. autoscaler still stuck on backoff; I'm going to clear the backoff flag in the autoscaler cluster state: ```kubectl exec -n infra autoscaler-0 -- /bin/autoscalerctl reset-backoff``` (doing now).
deploy-bot: autoscaler reset-backoff executed by ravi.
ops_oncall: cloud provider called back; they approved temporary +10 GPU quota for 30 minutes while support handles permanent increase. starting manual node creation to fill capacity.
eli: manual nodes accepted and starting. queue dropping to 6.2k. p95 2.7s p99 4.9s.
customer_success: updating customers: ETA for full recovery 20-30m, we have partial mitigations and quota increase. sending message to impacted customers now.
sre_lead: positive: fallback routing + eviction + emergency quota got us out of critical. follow-ups: - postmortem - improve autoscaler backoff logic - add proactive quota monitor for projected peak - automated fallback policy sooner in stack trace. assign owners.
maya: noted owners: postmortem (eli), autoscaler changes (ravi), quota monitor (ops_oncall), fallback tests (maya).
eli: creating incident page and initial timeline. drafting customer-facing postmortem.
ops_oncall: handing off to overnight oncall @ravi in 30m. if anything regresses, escalate to on-call-sre.
ravi: acknowledged, I'll keep watch on queue and provider case.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. queue length 6,200 -> trending down. severity degraded to P2.
customer_success: sent update to impacted customers and arranged credits for spikes.
sre_lead: closing running actions in this thread — leave notes in postmortem doc and tag follow-up PRs. great work everyone. :heart:
eli: locking thread, handoff complete.
